biography.plain_text: Christian G. Vaccari is an American businessman whose maritime interests grew from his family's Louisiana shipyard. A Louisiana State University business graduate, he became owner and chief executive of Leevac and helped found Hornbeck Offshore Services. His business interests combined commercial vessel construction with ownership in the offshore marine transport industry.

confidence.reason: Family ownership, executive career, education and connected fleet equity corroborate the identity card.

biography.html: Christian G. Vaccari is an American businessman whose maritime interests grew from his family's Louisiana shipyard. A Louisiana State University business graduate, he became owner and chief executive of Leevac and helped found Hornbeck Offshore Services. His business interests combined commercial vessel construction with ownership in the offshore marine transport industry.

long_biography.plain_text:
Shipbuilder Christian Vaccari worked closely with customers on the practical design of offshore supply vessels. For Aries Marine, Leevac's engineers collaborated with the operator on diesel-electric boats. Vaccari explained that a single central corridor freed space for other uses, while increasingly complex onboard systems required additional project engineers.

He also developed a production network across Louisiana. After Leevac acquired Tidewater's Houma yard, the company could divide construction work among three facilities. Some larger vessels moved from Jennings to Houma for completion because of height restrictions at the original yard. The acquired site combined repair work with new construction, extending what the business could handle.

confidence.reason: Contemporaneous interviews explain distinct design and production decisions without attributing naval engineering personally to him.
